memo: Bundle of today's two new parts (the third cell of an ON/OFF square whose base e3f465oc-1 = 0.467 is known): e3fu1-1 = fusion only, e3f465nn-1 = neural only, this = both. Ours: two-pipeline fusion (build_fu.py: A and B run as subprocess scripts, each seeing only its own datasets, /kaggle/working cleaned between them, per-molecule reciprocal-rank fusion 1/(10+r) of the two top-25 lists, equal weights, ties keep A's order; B dropped if it fails or would pass 8 h 35 min). A = build.py base=f465 ownco=1 lfrag=1 nn=0.25 (base: sanpier 'Candidate-aware PubChem promotion 0.465' frozen pipeline = dmitriigluzdov v16 + sanpier fix; ours: own COCONUT + lfrag; port, not ours: sanpier's neural rerank of the final 25 from 'PubChem + Neural025 - LB 0.466', dataset sanpier/casmi-spectrum-model-v1). B = build.py base=v22 ownco=1 (base: ahmedberatozer casmi26-v22-n1-challenger; ours: own COCONUT; e3v22ocg-1 = 0.465). Effect size: fusion expected to change top-1 on 5-10% of molecules, neural about one molecule's partial ranks. Hypothesis: LB > max(e3fu1-1, e3f465nn-1) if the two parts add. build_fu.py fu2 'base=f465 ownco=1 lfrag=1 nn=0.25' 'base=v22 ownco=1'.
